title: Single-Leg Flamingo Stance
goal: Explore single-Leg Flamingo Stance at a comfortable, adaptable level.
readiness: Child jumps on two feet comfortably and steps over obstacles.
steps: Stand together near a stable support on a non-slip floor.
Model briefly lifting one foot and invite a playful attempt, using a handhold as needed.
Switch sides or rest without a timed hold.
completionCriteria: Child explores balancing on either foot with a handhold as needed; no timed hold is required.
safety: Perform on padded or carpeted floor away from sharp furniture.
adaptations: Use shorter attempts, accessible materials or additional support.
Adapt the activity to your language, interests, health and current ability; participation does not require unassisted performance.
benefits: Offers adaptable practice with movement or everyday hand skills. Choose support and effort that feel comfortable.

title: Emotion Vocabulary Labeling & Co-Regulation
goal: Explore emotion Vocabulary Labeling & Co-Regulation at a comfortable, adaptable level.
readiness: Child identifies basic feelings like happy and sad in stories.
steps: Present 4 emotion flashcards (Happy, Sad, Angry, Surprised).
Ask child to identify the expression and mimic it physically.
Discuss simple scenarios: 'How does your friend feel when their toy breaks? What can we do to help?'.
completionCriteria: Child explores naming a feeling and a comforting response with adult support.
safety: Validate all emotions as acceptable; discuss healthy ways to express anger or sadness.
adaptations: Use shorter attempts, accessible materials or additional support.

benefits: Offers voluntary practice with shared attention, connection and expressing preferences or feelings.

title: Supported Snipping and Drawing
goal: Explore supported Snipping and Drawing at a comfortable, adaptable level.
readiness: Child holds crayons with fingers rather than full fist.
steps: Provide child-safe blunt scissors and 1-inch marked paper strips.

Guide child to make sequential snips along the line and practice drawing intersecting cross lines with a crayon.
completionCriteria: Child explores safe snipping or mark making with close adult help; each skill can be practised separately.
safety: Always supervise scissor use closely; use only child-safe blunt scissors.

title: Unilateral Hopping & Heel-Toe Tandem Walk

readiness: Child balances on one foot for 5+ seconds.

Demonstrate walking heel-to-toe along the line without stepping off to either side.

title: Changing Sorting Rules

Play the 'color game' first: sort red cards left, blue cards right.
Introduce the switch: 'Now we are playing the shape game! Rabbits go here, boats go there'.

completionCriteria: Child explores sorting by one feature and tries a new rule with help; no diagnostic score is used.
safety: Keep game playful and celebrate attempts without scolding mistakes.

completionCriteria: Child discusses what a story character may know or feel, with help and no pass/fail inference.
safety: Present as an intriguing puzzle without pressure.
adaptations: Use shorter attempts, accessible materials or additional support.
